关键词: Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets
主要内容: On May 7, 2012, Core Laboratories N.V. announced that its prospectus for dual-listing its shares on NYSE Euronext in Amsterdam has been approved by the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets. The dual-listing will not involve the issuance of new shares. The listing on NYSE Euronext Amsterdam will be effective on May 16, 2012, under the symbol 'CLB.'
